summary: Retain custom-element reaction stack/queue ordering for connected, disconnected, adopted, moved, and attributeChanged callbacks.

target.notes: Honor [CEReactions], enqueue upgrade/callback reactions in order, filter attributeChangedCallback by observedAttributes, invoke callbacks with element as this, and report callback exceptions per HTML rules.

caveats: Calling callbacks directly at mutation sites can produce wrong reentrancy and ordering.

tests.name: connected callback runs on connection
tests.input: let n=0; customElements.define('x-j2cs-g',class extends HTMLElement{connectedCallback(){n++}}); const e=document.createElement('x-j2cs-g'); document.body.append(e); console.log(n);

tests.name: only observed attributes trigger attribute callback
tests.input: let n=0; customElements.define('x-j2cs-h',class extends HTMLElement{static observedAttributes=['a']; attributeChangedCallback(){n++}}); const e=document.createElement('x-j2cs-h'); e.setAttribute('b','1'); e.setAttribute('a','1'); console.log(n);
